race.description: Macedon Ranges Glass - Emerging Stars Series Ht1 Mdn Plate
race.comment: FLYAWAY (4) brings the most convincing exposed form, having closed his first campaign with a strong third at Sale when beaten just over half a length on heavy ground after settling back. His Bendigo debut also had merit, and two trials since, including a close second at Flemington, point to a forward return for a yard that can improve lightly raced horses sharply. MONGOL HEER (6) is the obvious danger fresh, with first-time visors added after a Pakenham debut where he was beaten two and a half lengths despite beginning awkwardly and covering ground. His Cranbourne trial win adds to the sense he is ready to run well. FRONT PAGE EDITION (11) placed on debut at Cranbourne and has a strong stable behind her, but she also has to prove herself at the longer trip. BOURNE LEGACY (2) was solid on resumption and can build on that effort.
